title: Interval arithmetic to certified bound
obligation: Produce an outward-rounded enclosure for a specified function, domain, precision, and subdivision policy.
rejection_policy: Reject bounds without an explicit domain, rounding mode, precision, and backend version.
Reject an enclosure when singularities or domain exclusions are not represented.
Reject sampled floating-point extrema as interval certificates.
mathcert_route: check every subdivision covers the declared domain
verify the final interval implies the stated local bound
certify only the explicit enclosure claim
claim_boundary: An interval enclosure proves only the stated bound on the stated domain under the replayed arithmetic contract.
